Gadget options
This app can read all SMS (text) messages stored on your gadget.
Allows the app to make parts of itself persistent in memory. This can limit memory available to other apps slowing down the gadget.
Allows the app to have itself started as soon as the system has finished booting. This can make it take longer to start the gadget and allow the app to slow down the overall gadget by always running.
Allows the app to send sticky broadcasts, which remain after the broadcast ends. Excessive use may make the gadget slow or unstable by causing it to use too much memory.

Allows the app to read data about your contacts stored on your gadget. Apps will also have access to the accounts on your gadget that have created contacts. This may include accounts created by apps you have installed. This permission allows apps to save your contact data, and malicious apps may share contact data without your knowledge.
Allows the app to modify the data about your contacts stored on your gadget. This permission allows apps to delete contact data.
Allows the app to modify your gadget\'s call log, including data about incoming and outgoing calls. Malicious apps may use this to erase or modify your call log.
This app can read all calendar events stored on your gadget and share or save your calendar data.
This app can add, remove, or change calendar events on your gadget. This app can send messages that may appear to come from calendar owners, or change events without notifying their owners.
prevent gadget from sleeping
Allows the app to prevent the gadget from going to sleep.
Allows the app to use the gadget\'s infrared transmitter.
Allows the app to change the gadget\'s time zone.
Allows the app to get the list of accounts known by the gadget. This may include any accounts created by applications you have installed.
Allows the app to receive packets sent to all devices on a Wi-Fi network using multicast addresses, not just your gadget. It uses more power than the non-multicast mode.
Allows the app to configure the local Bluetooth gadget, and to discover and pair with remote devices.
Allows the app to connect the gadget to and disconnect the gadget from WiMAX networks.
Allows the app to view the configuration of Bluetooth on the gadget, and to make and accept connections with paired devices.
